children: Fifth Third will present at the 2026 Barclays Global Financial Services Conference and highlights Comerica conversion progress, scale metrics, and 3Q26 guidance.
Presentation at Barclays conference on Sept. 15, 2026; slides attached as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD disclosure.
Pro-forma scale: $300B assets, $234B deposits, ~1,500 U.S. branches as of 6/30/26, ranked top-10 U.S. bank.
Comerica conversion complete with 293 branches converted, ~600K customer accounts added, and $850M pre-tax run-rate expense synergies on track for Q4 2026.
3Q26 outlook vs 2Q26: NII up 2–2.5%, noninterest income up 1–3%, noninterest expense down 1–2%; net charge-off ratio 30–35 bps; effective tax rate 22.5%.
Growth strategy: 150+ planned de novo branches in Texas, focus on commercial payments, wealth, deposit expansion and footprint in high-growth MSAs.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
